targets.name: Bronze navigation disc behind the ship
targets.concealment: The little round plate is partly behind the ship and blends into matching brass circles and brown shelf shadows.

targets.name: Short telescope under the books
targets.concealment: The thin barrel lies flat along book edges and partly tucks under an ornate box.

targets.name: Small bronze elephant on the shelf
targets.concealment: The dark gold figure shares the shelf's carved and embossed texture, with one edge tucked behind nearby objects.

targets.name: Small keyring under the counter cloth
targets.concealment: The narrow shafts follow cabinet grain and repeat the nearby gold fittings; overlapping key bows break their silhouettes.

targets.name: Long brass calipers
targets.concealment: Two thin brass legs align with chart rolls and a fine brush; the patterned holder hides their lower ends.

targets.name: Central acanthus leaf on the mirror
targets.concealment: The leaf is carved from the same gilt wood as surrounding curls and repeats their upward lines and shadowed lobes.

targets.name: Small gilt flower on the gramophone base
targets.concealment: A modest star-flower clasp is integrated into the cabinet's gilt engraving and partly meets the gramophone edge.

targets.name: Blue fish painted among the vase leaves
targets.concealment: Blue fins merge with blue painted foliage and the image bends around the rounded vase.

targets.name: Dragonfly clasp above the brocade tassel
targets.concealment: Gold wing veins repeat the brocade scrolls, and its narrow body aligns with the tassel connector against a dark patterned fold.

targets.name: Gilt crescent beside the mirror
targets.concealment: The crescent shares curved gold lines with mirror trim and neighboring hanging cords; part of its edge meets the carved frame.

targets.name: Black-capped wooden rod among the charts
targets.concealment: The narrow wood shaft aligns with the rolled paper and is partly tucked into the crowded chart holder.

targets.name: Large globe on the foreground table
targets.concealment: Large terrestrial globe is an obvious foreground anchor.

targets.name: Large engraved gramophone horn
targets.concealment: The large gold horn and its cabinet stand out on the right.

targets.name: Large front hanging lantern
targets.concealment: Large warm lit lantern hangs prominently near the front of the passage.

targets.name: Sleeping striped cat on the chair
targets.concealment: The clearly striped cat rests on a red chair.

review.notes: Every target inspected against the finished source and regenerated contour context sheets. Names, full visible defining features, occlusion edges and negative-space holes repaired where needed. Difficulty is an authored estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration remains pending.
